editorial.text: Known changes to info on authorities/library funding/opening since last posting Camden – £1.6m (25%) budget cut, legal challenge being prepared. Doncaster – Second consultaton on closures recommended Northumberland – 5% budget cut, more “volunteer involvement”. Richmond – Heathfield Library closed, £400k made from its sale promised for new library which was never built. Library is in poorest area of borough. Suffolk – one more under threat (Sudbury), article suggests 29 (out of 44) already known to be under threat is just the first “phase”. West Sussex – big increase in library charges
editorial.html:
Known changes to info on authorities/library funding/opening since last posting Camden – £1.6m (25%) budget cut, legal challenge being prepared.
Doncaster – Second consultaton on closures recommended
Northumberland – 5% budget cut, more “volunteer involvement”.
Richmond – Heathfield Library closed, £400k made from its sale promised for new library which was never built. Library is in poorest area of borough.
Suffolk – one more under threat (Sudbury), article suggests 29 (out of 44) already known to be under threat is just the first “phase”.
West Sussex – big increase in library charges
